#TIMING BENCHMARK HELPERS
```{r benchmark-helpers}
compute_gps <- function(data, pcs) {
  rotated <- irlba::prcomp_irlba(t(data), n = pcs, retx = TRUE,
                                 center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
  loadings <- abs(rotated$rotation)
  rownames(loadings) <- rownames(data)

  eigenvalues <- rotated$sdev^2
  prop_var <- eigenvalues / sum(eigenvalues)

  percent_cont <- sweep(loadings, 2, colSums(loadings), FUN = "/")
  scaled_contr <- sweep(percent_cont, 2, prop_var, FUN = "*")
  rowSums(scaled_contr)
}

gps_cutoff <- function(tot_contr, cut) {
  sorted_contr <- sort(tot_contr, decreasing = TRUE)
  if (cut == 1) return(sorted_contr)

  result <- list()
  cumulative_gps <- 0
  for (i in seq_along(sorted_contr)) {
    if (is.na(sorted_contr[i]) || is.infinite(sorted_contr[i])) {
      stop("Error: contribution calculation produced NA or infinite values.")
    }
    result[[i]] <- as.numeric(sorted_contr[i])
    cumulative_gps <- cumulative_gps + as.numeric(sorted_contr[i])
    if (cumulative_gps >= cut) break
  }
  unlist(result)
}
```

#GRAPH 1: IRLBA VS FULL SVD TIMING BY PC COUNT
```{r irlba-vs-svd-timing}

pc_counts <- c(5, 10, 15, 20)

timing_results <- do.call(rbind, lapply(pc_counts, function(np) {
  irlba_t <- system.time(
    irlba::prcomp_irlba(t(data), n = np, retx = TRUE,
                        center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
  )["elapsed"]

  svd_t <- system.time({
    X <- scale(t(data), center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)
    sv <- svd(X, nu = np, nv = np)
    pc_scores <- sv$u %*% diag(sv$d[1:np])
    loadings  <- sv$v
  })["elapsed"]

  data.frame(pcs = np, irlba_time = irlba_t, svd_time = svd_t)
}))

timing_long <- tidyr::pivot_longer(timing_results,
                                   cols = c(irlba_time, svd_time),
                                   names_to = "Method",
                                   values_to = "Time")

ggplot2::ggplot(timing_long,
                ggplot2::aes(x = factor(pcs), y = Time, fill = Method)) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(position = ggplot2::position_dodge(width = 0.9)) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Number of PCs", y = "Time (seconds)", title = NULL) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal() + ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "none")
ggsave(filename = paste0(here(), "/Properties_and_Performance/PBMC_SVD_vs_IRLBA_timing.jpg"),, 
   dpi = 300)
```

#GRAPH 2: TIME PERFORMANCE OF GPS CUTOFF CALCULATION
```{r gps-cutoff-timing}
tot_contr <- compute_gps(data, pcs = 5)

cutoffs <- seq(0.10, 1.00, by = 0.05)

cutoff_bench <- do.call(rbind, lapply(cutoffs, function(ct) {
  reps <- 10
  times_ms <- replicate(reps, {
    t0 <- Sys.time()
    res <- gps_cutoff(tot_contr, ct)
    as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs")) * 1000
  })
  n_genes <- length(gps_cutoff(tot_contr, ct))
  data.frame(cut_pct = ct * 100,
             time_ms = median(times_ms),
             n_genes = n_genes)
}))

ggplot2::ggplot(cutoff_bench, ggplot2::aes(x = cut_pct, y = time_ms)) +
  ggplot2::geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE,
                       color = "blue", fill = "grey70", alpha = 0.5) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(color = "orange", size = 2) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(label = n_genes),
                     vjust = -1.2, size = 3, color = "grey30") +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(10, 100, by = 5)) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Cumulative GPS (%)", y = "Time (milliseconds)", title = NULL) +
  ggplot2::ylim(0, 35)+
  ggplot2::theme_minimal() + ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "none")
ggsave(filename = paste0(here(), "/Properties_and_Performance/PBMC_GPS_timing.jpg"),, 
   dpi = 300)
```
